title: docs(setup): slim the Setup overview to the genuinely-invisible rules
body:
## Why

Follow-up to [#1848](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1848). On review, the seeded `setup_overview` mixed two things: a few genuinely-invisible rules (worth documenting) and generic concept-restatement (permission-set vs role definitions) that duplicates what the Setup UI's own Users/Roles/Permission-set screens already show — then deferred to the external site per section. The ADR-0046 principle is "document the invisible, not what the UI shows," so the generic half doesn't earn its place.

## What

Trim `setup_overview` (EN + zh) to three short bullets the screens *don't* reveal:
- a user is **identity, not access** (and deactivate ≠ delete);
- permissions are **additive** (effective access = union of permission sets);
- **"can't see a record" is almost always sharing**, not object permissions.

`studio_overview` is left as-is — its overlay/precedence rule is exactly the kind of invisible gotcha this format is for.

Content only, no behaviour change.
